mapper.select:
SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, recipient_user_id, actor_user_id, source_type, source_id, object_type, object_id, shared_at, share_id, read_at, deleted_at FROM (
SELECT FROM user_inbox i JOIN gathering g ON g.id = i.source_id JOIN gathering_member member ON member.gathering_id = g.id AND member.user_id = #{userId} JOIN moment m ON m.id = i.object_id AND m.gathering_id = g.id WHERE AND i.source_type = 'gathering' AND i.object_type = 'moment' AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND member.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.author_user_id = i.actor_user_id
UNION ALL
SELECT FROM user_inbox i JOIN circle c ON c.id = i.source_id JOIN circle_member receiver ON receiver.circle_id = c.id AND receiver.user_id = #{userId} JOIN circle_share s ON s.id = i.share_id AND s.circle_id = c.id JOIN circle_member sender ON sender.circle_id = c.id AND sender.user_id = s.sharer_user_id JOIN moment m ON m.id = i.object_id AND m.author_user_id = s.sharer_user_id WHERE AND i.source_type = 'circle' AND i.object_type = 'moment' AND s.object_type = 'moment' AND s.object_id = i.object_id AND s.sharer_user_id = i.actor_user_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND receiver.deleted_at IS NULL AND sender.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT FROM user_inbox i JOIN circle c ON c.id = i.source_id JOIN circle_member receiver ON receiver.circle_id = c.id AND receiver.user_id = #{userId} JOIN circle_share s ON s.id = i.share_id AND s.circle_id = c.id JOIN circle_member sender ON sender.circle_id = c.id AND sender.user_id = s.sharer_user_id JOIN album a ON a.id = i.object_id AND a.owner_user_id = s.sharer_user_id WHERE AND i.source_type = 'circle' AND i.object_type = 'album' AND s.object_type = 'album' AND s.object_id = i.object_id AND s.sharer_user_id = i.actor_user_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND receiver.deleted_at IS NULL AND sender.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ) related ORDER BY shared_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{rowCount}
